author: The Pandorga contributors
description: Pandorga is a publishing platform: Jekyll shell, browser content runtime, JSON export pipeline, and Studio editor. Sites declare pages in a registry; the gem supplies templates, gates, and the pandorga CLI.

author: Envless
description: Fetches an environment's ciphertext from Envless, decrypts it on your machine and puts it in ENV, with typed reads, an on-disk cache and a Rails Railtie.
